name: yami-content
description: YAMI content writing standards — voice, bilingual parity, casing, writing structure, signature copy patterns

files.summary: Voice attributes: direct, action-oriented, commerce-native. Low cuteness, zero emoji, spec-led.
CN+EN parity on every surface. Inline (middle dot), stacked, or side-by-side pairing patterns.
Three-layer writing: Summary (what) → Definition (scope) → Rules (exactly how). Use 必须/不得/可以.
Title Case for EN CTAs, full-width CN punctuation, all numerals in GT Walsheim.
Signature UI copy templates: navigation, section titles, errors, empty states, badges, product cards, checkout.

crossLink.rationale: Content spec (this dir) defines HOW to write. Copy library stores WHAT is written.
